_note: Held-out evaluation set. Synthetic or fully redacted only, per the PS constraint - no real victim data. Roughly half genuine, so the false-alarm rate is measurable and the model is forced to learn what legitimate institutional communication looks like.
_labels: scam | genuine | ambiguous. 'ambiguous' cases are correct when the system says SUSPICIOUS or UNCERTAIN rather than committing.
